title: teucrium rotundifolium var. atlanticum
intro: Teucrium rotundifolium var. atlanticum, commonly known as Atlantic germander, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the Atlantic coast of Europe, valued for its medicinal properties and rich in bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Atlantic germander include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic uses in treating liver diseases and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Atlantic germander include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to exhibit various therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
